records.rationale: The diff changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which inverts the condition: previously the live `slug` was set only when team billing was DISABLED; now it is set only when billing is ENABLED.
